Thought in dialogue

Essays by Alessandro Gentili

Essay 06 · Fenomenologia del potere (in Italian)

Interpretive connection. The essay examines power that shapes perceptions, emotions and judgments before issuing commands. Seneca’s account of self-mastery offers a perspective from which to examine this dependence.

Essay 08 · Il costo della complessità (in Italian)

Interpretive connection. The essay examines the contraction of the time needed for thought. Seneca’s reflections on the dissipation of life offer a critical perspective on the loss of duration and attention.
